# freshdesk_automation_rules (Data Source)

Every automation rule of one type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_automation_rules" "example" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `rule_type` (Number) Which automation to list: `1` ticket creation (dispatcher), `3` time triggers, `4` ticket updates (observer).

### Read-Only

- `automation_rules` (Attributes List) The rules belonging to the requested automation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--automation_rules))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.

<a id="nestedatt--automation_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `automation_rules`

Read-Only:

- `actions` (String) Actions the rule applies, as JSON.
- `active` (Boolean) Whether the rule is running.
- `affected_tickets_count` (Number) How many tickets the rule has acted on.
- `conditions` (String) Condition sets, as JSON.
- `created_at` (String) When the rule was created (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description of the rule.
- `events` (String) Field changes the rule watches, as JSON.
- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the rule.
- `name` (String) Name of the rule.
- `operator` (String) How the condition sets combine.
- `outdated` (Boolean) Whether the rule references a missing field.
- `performer` (String) Who must act for the rule to fire, as JSON.
- `position` (Number) Evaluation order within the automation.
- `updated_at` (String) When the rule was last changed (RFC 3339).
